column2: Thanking me... Oh, not at all. I only did what I could, and above all, it was the heroes' strength that saved Arcaya.{wait}{clear}
I see... I suppose so... I like that you can say that so plainly.{wait}{clear}
Huh?! L-Lord Michael...?!{wait}{clear}
Hahaha...! From now on, you'll be here in the Heavens too. Let's talk again anytime.{wait}{clear}Don't just visit Raphael and Gabriel. Come see me once in a while too. See you.{wait}{clear}
Oh, um... Lord Michael!{wait}{clear}
Hehe... Forgive him, ＄＄＄＄＄＄. Michael insisted that he had to see you, so he has been waiting here all this time.{wait}{clear}
I'm very happy that Lord Michael would wait for me.{wait}{clear}

I see... Thank you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}And you truly saw it through to the end. Surely it is because you and the heroes trusted one another and joined all your strength together.{wait}{clear}You drew out their potential and their strength to stand against fate.{wait}{clear}And it is because you could lead them toward hope that peace has come to Arcaya.{wait}{clear}Let me thank you too, from the bottom of my heart. Thank you, ＄＄＄＄＄＄.{wait}{clear}

From now on, you will return to the Heavens and take up new duties.{wait}{clear}I am sure it is very sad not to see those heroes again, but you can no longer descend to the land of Arcaya.{wait}{clear}
Um, excuse me, Lord Raphael, about that...{wait}{clear}
What is it, ＄＄＄＄＄＄?{wait}{clear}
I want to go to the surface.{n}
I want to go back to the surface... to Arcaya. I want to live out my life there as a human being.{wait}{clear}...Together with someone...{wait}{clear}
......{wait}{clear}Angels who descend to the world below are troubled by that decision... So you, too, choose that path...{wait}{clear}
Please, Lord Raphael!{wait}{clear}
Very well... I will allow you to live in Arcaya.{wait}{clear}But do not forget: becoming human means you will inherit that blood as well... It is a very painful thing.{wait}{clear}
Yes... I understand. I will never give in to that blood.{wait}{clear}
Indeed... I am sure you will be all right.{wait}{clear}＄＄＄＄＄＄... Along with your pure white wings, please do not lose what is precious to you as well...{wait}{clear}
Yes... Thank you very much, Lord Raphael.{wait}{clear}
Now, before you go to Arcaya, there are some little ones you must see.{wait}{clear}
So you have decided to live on the surface as a human.{wait}{clear}
I am a little lonely, thinking I will not see you again...{wait}{clear}
But it is your decision, Angel, so all I can do is see you off.{wait}{clear}
Please never forget that kind heart of yours. Farewell...{wait}{clear}
Angeeel, you're going down to the surface? Florin's gonna be super lonely...{wait}{clear}
But, but, you already decided, right, Angel...?{wait}{clear}
Then Florin will pray forever and ever that you'll be happy down there, Angel.{wait}{clear}
And don't you ever forget Florin and everybody, okay?!{wait}{clear}
Angel, becoming human... You've chosen a hard road...{wait}{clear}
But you'll be fine, Angel, won't you? I believe it!{wait}{clear}
I won't get to see you anymore, so I'll be lonely, but I'll always be cheering for you, Angel.{wait}{clear}
Good luck!{wait}{clear}
...I see. So you have decided to live on the surface as a human.{wait}{clear}
It's very lonely not getting to see you anymore, but...{wait}{clear}
Please don't forget the heart you've had all this time, Angel, and do your best.{wait}{clear}
And... please don't forget us, either.{wait}{clear}
Huh? Angel, you're becoming human?{wait}{clear}
No way, I think being human is way harder... Are you sure?{wait}{clear}
But you already decided, right, Angel... Hmmm.{wait}{clear}
I won't get to see you anymore, so I'll be lonely.{wait}{clear}
Even after you're human, don't forget me, okay?!{wait}{clear}
Um... Angel, is it true you're becoming human?{wait}{clear}
Are you sure? I think being human is harder...{wait}{clear}
Oh, oh, but you're the Angel, so I'm sure you'll be fine, right?{wait}{clear}
Um, I'll pray... that you'll always live in good health, Angel...{wait}{clear}
You've decided to live on the surface as a human?{wait}{clear}
I suppose it's a very you choice, Angel...{wait}{clear}
Well... please never forget that kind heart of yours.{wait}{clear}
It's a shame I won't see you again, but take care.{wait}{clear}
I never thought you would choose the path of living as a human, Angel.{wait}{clear}
But I am sure you have your reasons.{wait}{clear}
I expect you will face many hardships from now on, but I believe you will surely overcome them.{wait}{clear}
Please stay well always, and do your best.{wait}{clear}
...Thank you...{wait}{clear}
